C1.worst_defect: Three blocks of grey copy stand between the H1 and the product shot: a 4-line lede (6 lines at 390 px), the button row, then a second 2-line note "Your own store needs the plugin on your Vendure server first..." under the buttons. At phone width the screenshot only starts at about y=1160 px, so the first screen is all text.

C2.worst_defect: The one mixed signal is the comparison table. The live demo answers "Yes" to "Refund a sale at the till" while a real store gets a 4-line "No, not on plugin 0.3.0..." cell. The demo visibly does more than the product does, and only the table says so.
C2.where: home.desktop.02, 'Live demo or your own store' table, Refund row

C3.worst_defect: Quick start is 9 steps and ~12 code/terminal blocks with no screenshot at all. Step 8 'Sign in and make a sale' (a-i) and 'Check it worked' describe the sign-in screen and the synced Vendure order in words only, so there is no picture of what success looks like.

C4.worst_defect: UI strings are styled two ways on the same page. Header states are monospace code chips ("N orders waiting to send", "Closing — waiting for N orders"), while the header notices a few lines below are plain quoted body text ("The store refused this sign-in..."). A reader can't tell which style means 'exact text on screen'.
C4.where: troubleshooting.desktop.01, 'Check whether a sale has reached the store' vs 'Act on a header notice'

C5.worst_defect: 'What it does today' has two treatments. Two bordered cards with buttons are followed by eight unboxed heading+paragraph pairs, so the grid looks half-finished. The right card 'Every sale lands once' also has a ~60 px dead gap above its button, because it is stretched to match the taller left card.

C6.worst_defect:
On 390 px, code blocks soft-wrap with a hanging indent that looks like real nesting. In generateMigration(config, { name:
  'AddVendurePos', outputDir:
  './src/migrations' }) and taxLineCalculationStrategy: new
    DefaultTaxLineCalculationStrategy(), continuation lines sit at the same indent as real child lines, so the structure of the snippet reads wrong.

C7.worst_defect: Search API snippets carry raw hard line breaks mid-sentence ("Customer search and adding a\ncustomer need a connection..."), so a result preview renders ragged. Otherwise the 404 status, llms.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD and Lighthouse 98/100/100/100 are all clean.

overall_worst.defect: At 390 px, the quick start's code blocks soft-wrap with continuation lines indented exactly like real nested lines. generate-migration.ts and the taxOptions block read as different code from what they are, and these are the snippets a developer copies and checks by eye on the main install path.
overall_worst.fix: Either reformat the long snippets so no line exceeds ~42 characters (break at argument and property boundaries), or keep horizontal scroll for code blocks below 640 px instead of soft wrap.
